name: multiply
description: FlagOS #6613. OpenCV CUDA reference opencv_contrib@b67a855188a3d683813731010f6d39ac614733a4/modules/cudaarithm/src/cuda/mul_mat.cu. Multiply a by b with scale fixed to 1. Float32 uses ordinary multiplication. Uint8 saturates to 255 on overflow. The tensors are nonempty equally shaped contiguous single-channel HxW matrices of the same dtype (float32 or uint8), without a mask. Write every element of the independent preallocated destination and return it. Preserve the source tensors.
